## Independent other-role reviews

- [ ] At least two accepted reviews are linked below.
- [ ] Both reviewers have roles different from the author and from each other.
- [ ] Reviewers are different people or agents; neither is an author or coauthor.
- [ ] Each review binds the current source hashes and actual positive and negative checks, including tests, failures, skips and cancellations. Historical receipts are labelled historical.

| 1 | required | required | required | required |
| 2 | required | required | required | required |

## Material technical claims

Every material technical claim requires a label and an evidence link, including a label from each independent reviewer.

Allowed labels: **Verified / Partially verified / Unsupported / Incorrect / Outdated**.

| Material technical claim | Author label | Reviewer 1 label | Reviewer 2 label | Exact source/evidence link | Resolution or next action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| required | one allowed label | one allowed label | one allowed label | required | required |

- [ ] No material technical claim is omitted or inferred verified from a lock pin, passing fixture, source hash or review vote.
- [ ] Conflicts and resolutions are recorded in [DECISIONS.md](../contoso-corr-poc/DECISIONS.md), with the winning source and its evidence-hierarchy level.
- [ ] Majority vote is not evidence. A resolution without a source is rejected.
